name: st-pauls-cathedral
description: English Baroque cathedral with surveyed dome stages, paired western belfries, open peristyle and columned porticoes.

placement_evidence.anchor: centre of mapped dome pieces; EN offset (+2.6983,-7.0883) from survey anchor
placement_evidence.heading: perpendicular to line joining mapped western belfry centres
placement_evidence.width: 75m between transept walls; mapped semicircular porticoes extend the full plan to approximately86.4m
placement_evidence.base: 16.1m AOD, published top-of-cross AOD127.7 minus architectural height111.6; surrounding engine terrain16–17m

interpretive_details: Window mouldings, figure silhouettes and stone-course coloration are simplified from exterior photographs; primary lengths and vertical stages follow the cited survey.
geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
